nameEn: Processing and preserving of meat and meat products
description: This class includes the processing and preserving of meat and meat products. It includes slaughtering and dressing of animals, processing of meat, production of canned meat products, and other meat processing activities.
includes: production of cured and dried meat
production of meat extracts and essences
excludes: slaughtering activities, see 1010 if integrated with processing
production of meat by-products (e.g. hides), see appropriate class
